payout_quote: Click 'Redeem Now'... Members can redeem their points for valuable rewards including cash through PayPal or bank transfer and gift cards... You must reach a minimum of 500 points to redeem. There is no maximum limit for redemption. (Official Survey Junkie Help Center) ... Redeem your points instantly for cash via PayPal or e-Giftcards. (Official How It Works page)
timing: Points credit after each survey; redeem instantly for PayPal cash once you hit 500 points ($5); bank transfers take 3-4 business days
eligibility: 13+ (minors need parental permission); US, Canada, Australia and UK residents; free account
steps: Create a free Survey Junkie account (email, Google or Facebook)
Complete your profile surveys so you get matched to relevant surveys
Take surveys from the feed - each shows its point value and estimated time
Redeem instantly for PayPal cash, bank transfer or e-gift cards
catches: 100 points = $1, and you cannot cash out until 500 points ($5) - small surveys pay 20-50 cents each, so the first payout takes a while
You will get disqualified from many surveys after answering pre-screeners (you get a few consolation points, not the full amount)
Survey Junkie is explicit that brands need specific demographics - not everyone qualifies for every survey
Earnings are modest - this is pocket money per survey, not a wage; heavy users earn more only by completing many surveys
biggest_catch: Expect roughly $1-$3 per completed survey at ~15 minutes each, and you can't touch a cent until 500 points ($5). This is pocket money with a slow first payout, not a wage.
notes: REJECTED 2026-09-23 strict audit: official evidence proves redemption mechanics (500-point minimum, instant PayPal cash, bank transfer, e-gift cards) but no first-party source proves a concrete current per-survey payout amount or the 100-points-=$1 conversion. The $1-$3/survey range and 20-50-cent small-survey claims are unsupported. Fails the concrete-amount rule.
maximize: Finish every profile questionnaire on day one - Survey Junkie's matching runs on your profile, so a complete profile is how you qualify for more surveys. In the survey feed, each survey shows its point value and estimated time upfront: divide points by minutes and take the best ratios first. Answer pre-screeners carefully and consistently - rushing or contradicting yourself triggers disqualifications that waste your time.
